integrity: Two standalone Python 3 checkers, recorded outputs and a self-contained all-parameter argument are included. Finite graph simulations are corroboration, not the infinite-family proof.
scientific_limitations: The asserted quantities are limiting excitation rates and their exact initial-colouring populations, not transient distributions or complete orbit periods. The proof uses the published finite-graph cycle-integral theorem of Gravner, Lyu and Sivakoff (2016). Unindexed historical equivalents remain possible; no independent scientific audit has occurred.
title: A single internal edge produces an exact three-rate excitation law
